name: A Rogue's Deal
summary: Calvin Montague offers work to newly awakened Forsaken in Deathknell. He promises wealth for delivering a letter, but refuses payment when the work is done.

sections.title: A Dishonorable Promise
sections.body: In Deathknell, Calvin Montague offers newly risen Forsaken work for good coin. He asks them to deliver a letter, but when they return, he pretends no bargain was made and denies owing them anything.

sections.title: Paying the Price
sections.body: When you demand the promised silver, Calvin Montague draws his weapons instead. He expects an inexperienced Forsaken to be easy to cut down. Defeated, he gives you some coin and admits he lied about the payout because he thought he could get away with it.

faq.q: Why does Calvin Montague attack when asked for payment?
faq.answer: Calvin Montague is an unscrupulous rogue who never meant to share his coin. When you confront him over the broken promise, he tries to silence you rather than pay, assuming a newly raised Forsaken will be an easy mark.

faq.q: Where does this confrontation take place?
faq.answer: The confrontation takes place in Deathknell, the ruined village in southwestern Tirisfal Glades where newly risen Forsaken first awaken.

faq.q: Does Calvin Montague actually pay what he promised?
faq.answer: No. After you beat him, Calvin Montague surrenders and hands over some coin, far less than he originally offered. He admits he lied about the full amount from the start.

faq.q: How is this second task unlocked?
faq.answer: After you complete Calvin Montague's initial letter delivery, return and demand the promised coin. When you challenge his deceit, the fight begins.

faq.q: Does Calvin Montague die when defeated?
faq.answer: No. Calvin Montague yields before taking a fatal blow, compliments your fighting skill, and begrudgingly opens his coin pouch to save his own skin.

faq.q: What lesson does this encounter offer to new Forsaken?
aliases: what is the point of rogue deal
faq.answer: For new Forsaken, the encounter offers a practical lesson in harsh realities: honor is scarce among the undead, words are cheap, and respect is earned only through martial strength.

angles.text: As a young rogue, dealing with Calvin Montague teaches you to trust no one, watch your purse, and never let another scoundrel walk away with your cut.
As a Forsaken, waking in Deathknell quickly shows you that death does not strip away humanity's pettiest vices. Forsaken cutpurses swindle their own kin as readily as living bandits.
